verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a repo-resident `.coderabbit.yaml` config file, including an org-wide central config repository and a command that shows the resolved YAML. It also documents path filters that exclude lock files and generated code, and glob-based per-path review instructions. Missing for 10: any evidence of selectable review profiles, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the config-file workflow.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I configure the reviewer with a versioned config file in my repo — path filters, per-path instructions, review profiles

citations.quote: Create a `coderabbit` repository in your organization and add your `.coderabbit.yaml` file
Use the `@coderabbitai configuration` command on any PR to get the resolved configuration in YAML format.
Path filters exclude files that don't benefit from review: lock files, binaries, and generated code.
Customize how CodeRabbit reviews different parts of your codebase using glob patterns. Apply focused, context-aware instructions to controllers, tests, documentation, and more.
Configure when and how CodeRabbit automatically reviews pull requests using the `reviews.auto_review` settings.
